prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square waist-up profile illustration of ONE original adult human man of Gondor for The One Ring. Match the established approved warm brown linework portrait collection. Use the preceding Rivendell portrait as a STYLE reference only, not for facial features, clothing or pose. Fine muted umber and reddish-brown pencil/pen contours, medium-density visible directional hatching and crosshatching, small rich dark brown recesses and broad pale cream paper highlights.
Subject: a disciplined experienced Gondorian defender in his early forties, strong human proportions, straight unpointed ears, square jaw, short dark hair brushed back, close-trimmed beard, weathered cheek and brow, steady resolute eyes and composed serious expression. Distinct human face, no elf traits. Practical mail shirt visible at neck and sleeves under a clean but worn surcoat bearing a finely outlined stylized white tree emblem, represented as pale paper reserved between brown strokes. Broad simple leather belt, sturdy plain shoulder cape pinned at one side. Head uncovered for a readable character portrait. A plain sheathed sword at his side with one hand resting naturally on the pommel. Understated Gondorian craftsmanship, modest stitched edging, no crown or royal regalia.
Three-quarter view, head centered with generous space above for avatar cropping, include upper torso, hand and sword hilt in square. Moderately stylized traditional fantasy book character illustration, no photographic actor likeness. Model face through selective contours and short hatch clusters under brow, beside nose and below jaw. Mail suggested with economical linked marks, folds with directional hatching; large lit surfaces remain unshaded paper. Light nearly white ivory paper background, faint sparse hatch strokes immediately behind shoulders fade to blank. No landscape, text, border, watermark, full-color fills, smooth blended realistic shading, pores, gray graphite wash, thick cartoon outlines or sparse coloring-book simplicity. One character only. Square 1:1 intended final 640x640 WebP profile.
